title: Nuevo Laredo responds to chickenpox cases at Estado de Tamaulipas elementary school
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo’s municipal government sent a health brigade to the Estado de Tamaulipas elementary school in the south of the city after chickenpox cases were reported among students, with 21 students in one group affected.
content:
The municipal government of Nuevo Laredo sent a health brigade to the Estado de Tamaulipas elementary school in the south of the city after chickenpox cases were reported among students, according to Periódico Valle del Norte.

The brigade, coordinated with the Distrito de Salud para el Bienestar V, the Centro Regional de Desarrollo Educativo (CREDE) and the DIF system, brought guidance, supplies and medical care options to families, the newspaper reported. Officials said 21 students in a single group were reported affected, and a review was carried out to confirm which cases were actually chickenpox.

Liliana Arjona, the city’s Secretary of Social Welfare, said chickenpox is a seasonal viral illness that spreads more easily when temperature changes keep students indoors together, and she urged calm, according to Valle del Norte. She said children who are sick should stay home, wash their hands well and keep their spaces ventilated to stop further spread.

As part of the visit, the brigade offered vaccination services, treatments for lice, oral rehydration salts and medical guidance for families, the newspaper reported. The city said its 12 Clínicas UNE have medicine to treat chickenpox symptoms such as fever and itching, and families with a sick child can go to any of them for evaluation and care.

The medical recommendation is for children with chickenpox to stay home for about two weeks, because the virus can spread from days before the skin lesions appear until all the scabs have disappeared, according to Valle del Norte.

The response comes days after chickenpox cases were reported at another Nuevo Laredo elementary school, in the Kilómetro 18 area.

Source: Periódico Valle del Norte, Nov. 12, 2026.
